name: Initialize project scaffolding
done_when: I can run the frontend and backend based on commands in README.md and I can view the frontend in my browser

name: Backend: Accept video file uploads
done_when: POST /api/upload accepts multipart form data with video file, saves to temp directory, returns upload ID

name: Frontend: Complete upload flow
done_when: Upload page sends file to backend and shows upload progress and result

name: Backend: Integrate whisper-server
done_when: Backend can send video to whisper and receive transcription with timestamps

name: Backend: Generate SRT files
done_when: Backend generates valid SRT subtitle files from whisper output

name: Frontend: Subtitle viewer
done_when: User can view subtitles synced with video playback

name: Backend: SQLite database
done_when: Videos and subtitles stored in SQLite with proper schema

name: Backend: File encryption at rest
done_when: Uploaded files encrypted with age, decrypted on access

name: API: Download SRT endpoint
done_when: GET /api/videos/:id/subtitles.srt returns downloadable SRT file

name: Frontend: List uploaded videos
done_when: Homepage or videos page lists user's uploaded videos

name: Backend: Authentication system
done_when: Email/password registration and login with sessions

name: Frontend: Auth pages
done_when: Login, register, and logout pages work with backend

name: Backend: Upload limits for anonymous
done_when: Anonymous users limited to 2 uploads, tracked by session

name: Backend: Auto-delete old files
done_when: Cron/scheduler deletes anonymous files after 48hr, registered after 90 days

name: Frontend: Subtitle editor
done_when: User can edit subtitle text and timing in browser

name: Backend: Transcript paste-and-match
done_when: User can paste transcript and backend aligns with whisper tokens

name: Backend: Embed subtitles in video
done_when: Backend can burn subtitles into video file for download

name: Backend: 2FA with TOTP
done_when: Users can enable Google Authenticator style 2FA

name: Write tests
done_when: Unit and integration tests for backend and frontend

name: Create TESTING.md documentation
done_when: TESTING.md exists with instructions for running backend and frontend tests, test commands, and info about test coverage

name: Create INSTALL.md documentation
done_when: INSTALL.md exists with instructions for installing all project dependencies (Go, Node.js, ffmpeg, whisper-cli)

name: Create LINTERS.md documentation
done_when: LINTERS.md exists with linting setup and commands

name: Create BROWSER_TESTING.md documentation
done_when: BROWSER_TESTING.md exists with browser automation testing instructions

name: Frontend: Console log forwarding to backend
done_when: Frontend forwards console.log/warn/error to backend /api/log endpoint in dev mode only

name: Implement BROWSER_TESTING.md setup
done_when: Playwright installed, e2e/ directory exists, npm run test:e2e runs with at least one passing test

name: Create specs for major features
done_when: specs/auth.md, specs/encryption.md, specs/totp.md exist with design docs

name: Backend: Switch from whisper-cli to whisper-server
done_when: Backend uses whisper-server API instead of spawning whisper-cli process, configurable server URL via env var

name: Fix upload progress and SRT download
done_when: Upload progress updates smoothly (not stuck at 30%), SRT download works after transcription completes

name: Audit: Compare capabilities vs specs/docs
done_when: Read specs/subtitler.md, README.md, and all documentation. Test each advertised feature. Add new TASKS for any gaps between what's documented and what actually works

name: Create verification scripts and pre-commit hook
done_when: Helper scripts exist for linting, unit tests, and browser tests. Pre-commit hook runs all verification scripts. Scripts documented in AGENTS.md

name: Fill in TODOs in specs/subtitler.md
done_when: All TODO items in specs/subtitler.md are either completed (research done, plans written) or converted to explicit tasks in TASKS.jsonl

name: Document whisper-server passthrough for qemu VM
done_when: Documentation exists for how to pass whisper-server IP:port into qemu VM, env vars documented in backend/README.md

name: Write deployment plan
done_when: specs/deployment.md exists with plan for Mac Mini qemu VM deployment, Caddy frontend, and static file hosting

name: Research Mac Metal via MoltenVK to qemu
done_when: Research doc exists explaining feasibility and steps for Metal GPU passthrough to qemu VM

name: Plan webhook-deployer integration
done_when: Plan exists for triggering deploys via pub_musings/webhook-deployer for frontend and backend

name: Add debugging documentation
done_when: README.md has Debugging section with instructions for Go Delve and frontend TypeScript debugging

name: Backend: 2FA recovery codes
done_when: Users get 10 single-use recovery codes when enabling 2FA. Codes are hashed and stored in database. Users can use one recovery code to disable 2FA. Tests pass.

name: Backend: Rate limiting for auth endpoints
done_when: Login, register, and TOTP verify endpoints have rate limiting (e.g., 5 attempts per minute per IP). Returns 429 Too Many Requests when exceeded. Tests pass.

name: Frontend: Display recovery codes after 2FA setup
done_when: Security page displays recovery codes after enabling 2FA. Shows copy button, warning message, and confirmation checkbox. User must acknowledge before continuing.

name: Frontend: Add recovery option to login page
done_when: Login page has 'Lost access to authenticator?' link. Shows recovery form with email, password, and recovery code fields. Calls /api/auth/totp/recover endpoint.

name: Backend: Rate limit TOTP setup and disable endpoints
done_when: /api/auth/totp/setup and /api/auth/totp/disable are rate limited at 5 req/min per IP. Tests pass.

name: Regenerate recovery codes feature
done_when: Backend has POST /api/auth/totp/codes endpoint (requires auth + password + TOTP code, returns new codes). Frontend security page has 'Regenerate Recovery Codes' button for users with 2FA enabled. Tests pass.

name: Address spec feedback
done_when: All feedback in FEEDBACK.md has been addressed and added to their corresponding specs/*.md files

name: Smart lyrics alignment
done_when: When user pastes known lyrics for an uploaded video, backend intelligently aligns lyrics with whisper tokens, fixing transcription errors while preserving accurate timing. Create specs/lyrics-alignment.md with algorithm design.

name: Clean room model evaluation framework
done_when: Create specs/evaluation-cleanroom.md with test framework design. Include: TTS-generated test audio (reproducible seeds), WER measurement script, timing alignment measurement, model comparison (large-v3 vs large-v3-turbo vs medium). Test files should not be committed (generated on demand).

name: Design template analysis with Playwright
done_when: Use Playwright to visit anthropic.com and ampcode.com, capture screenshots and HAR files. Analyze what makes them easy to navigate. Create specs/design-template.md with findings and recommended design principles for our landing page.

name: Self-hosted QR code generation
done_when: Backend generates QR codes using go-qrcode library. /api/auth/totp/setup returns base64 PNG in qr_code field. Frontend uses data URL instead of external qrserver.com. No cross-origin requests needed. Tests pass.

name: Research MoltenVK for qemu GPU passthrough
done_when: Execute Phase 1 of specs/metal-moltenvk.md: clone MoltenVK, build it, run vkcube demo. Document results. Research qemu Vulkan support status. Update spec with findings.

name: Frontend: Use validation utilities in forms
done_when: Import and use validateEmail, validatePassword, validateTotpCode from validation.ts in login.astro, register.astro, and security.astro. Show inline validation errors before form submit. Tests pass.

name: E2E: Add auth flow tests
done_when: Create e2e/auth.spec.ts with tests for: registration success/failure, login success/failure, 2FA setup, 2FA login, recovery code login, logout. All tests pass.

name: Frontend: Add lyrics mode toggle to upload page
done_when: When pasting transcript on upload page, show toggle for 'Known lyrics mode' which sends mode:'lyrics' to align API. Include tooltip explaining the difference.

name: Backend: Rate limit upload/transcribe/burn endpoints
done_when: Add rate limiting to /api/upload (10/min), /api/transcribe (5/min), /api/videos/:id/burn (2/min) to prevent DoS. Tests verify 429 response.

name: Backend: Add session management API
done_when: GET /api/auth/sessions returns user's active sessions. DELETE /api/auth/sessions/:id revokes a session. Include device/IP info. Frontend security.astro shows session list with revoke buttons. Tests pass.

name: Docs: Create API documentation
done_when: Create docs/API.md with all endpoints, request/response schemas, authentication requirements, and example curl commands.

name: Backend: Migrate QR code library
done_when: Replace skip2/go-qrcode with yeqown/go-qrcode or another well-maintained library. Update totp/totp.go and tests. verify-all.sh passes.

name: Backend: Script conversion/transliteration library
done_when: Create specs/script-conversion.md with library evaluation. Implement backend endpoint to detect script and convert text (e.g., romanized → Devanagari). Add to align API as optional post-processing. Tests pass.

name: Frontend: Language and script selection UI
done_when: Upload page allows user to specify source language and target script for subtitles. Show valid scripts per language. Default to common native script. Update align/transcribe API calls with script preference.

name: Backend: Email service with Resend API
done_when: Create specs/email.md with design. Implement email service with Resend API integration. Add mock library for unit tests. Support password reset emails. Document RESEND_API_KEY env var.

name: Password reset flow
done_when: Backend: POST /api/auth/forgot-password sends reset email with token, POST /api/auth/reset-password validates token and resets password. Frontend: Add forgot password link to login, create reset password page. Tests pass.

name: Backend: Add video MIME type validation on upload
done_when: Upload endpoint validates MIME type against whitelist (video/mp4, video/webm, video/quicktime, video/x-m4v, video/mpeg). Returns 400 for invalid types. Client-side validation shows error before upload. Tests pass.

name: Frontend: Show retention countdown on videos list
done_when: Anonymous videos show 'Expires in X hours' countdown. Registered user videos show '90-day retention' info. Countdown updates without refresh (or on refresh).

name: Frontend: Add recovery codes download button
done_when: Security settings page shows 'Download Recovery Codes' button when 2FA is enabled. Downloads codes as text file. Works alongside regenerate feature.

name: Backend: Enable Secure flag on session cookies in production
done_when: Add HTTPS_ONLY env var that enables Secure flag on session cookies when set. Document in backend/README.md and specs/auth.md.

name: Backend: Add retry logic to whisper-server requests
done_when: Add exponential backoff retry (3 attempts, 1s/2s/4s delays) for whisper-server HTTP requests. Log retry attempts. Return original error if all retries fail.

name: Frontend: Implement upload progress bar
done_when: Upload page shows actual upload progress (bytes/percentage) using FormData upload events. Shows 'Uploading... X%' during transfer, then 'Processing...' during transcription.

name: Backend: Add per-email rate limiting for login failures
done_when: After 5 failed login attempts for an email, lock that email for 15 minutes regardless of IP. Store in database with automatic expiry cleanup. Prevents distributed brute force.

name: Docs: Update API.md with missing endpoints
done_when: API.md includes all session management endpoints (GET /api/auth/sessions, DELETE /api/auth/sessions/{id}), complete script conversion docs, and password reset endpoints.

name: Backend: Add rate limiting to detect-script endpoint
done_when: POST /api/text/detect-script wrapped with scriptLimiter.Wrap() like the /api/text/convert endpoint. Test verifies 429 response after limit exceeded.

name: Backend: Add VTT export format
done_when: GET /api/videos/{id}/subtitles.vtt returns WebVTT format. Documented in API.md. Frontend shows VTT download option. Tests verify valid VTT output.

name: Backend: Add JSON export format
done_when: GET /api/videos/{id}/subtitles.json returns JSON with segments array. Documented in API.md. Frontend shows JSON download option. Tests verify valid JSON output.

name: Frontend: Add accessibility improvements
done_when: All form inputs have proper labels, aria-label on icon-only buttons, role=status on status messages, focus visible on all interactive elements. Test with keyboard navigation.

name: Backend: Add request ID to all requests for tracing
done_when: Middleware generates UUID request ID, adds X-Request-ID header to response, includes in all log messages. Helps debugging production issues.

name: IMPORTANT Video reprocessing feature
done_when: Backend has POST /api/videos/{id}/reprocess endpoint (requires auth, owns video or admin). Frontend videos list shows 'Reprocess' button for failed transcriptions. E2E test validates reprocessing flow works after simulated failure.

name: Backend: Enhanced health check endpoint
done_when: GET /api/health returns JSON with: db_connected (bool), whisper_available (bool when configured), disk_space_ok (bool). Returns 503 if any dependency unavailable. Tests pass.

name: Backend: Add database transaction safety for critical ops
done_when: Multi-step operations (2FA setup + recovery codes, password reset + session invalidation) wrapped in database transactions. Test partial failures rollback cleanly.

name: Frontend: Mobile responsive design audit
done_when: All pages tested on mobile viewports (375px, 414px). Touch-friendly buttons (min 44px). Video player and subtitle editor work on tablet. Test with Chrome DevTools device emulation.

name: Frontend: Dark mode support
done_when: Add dark mode toggle in header. CSS variables for theme colors. Persist preference in localStorage. Test all pages in dark mode for contrast.

name: Docs: Create rate limits reference
done_when: Create docs/RATE_LIMITS.md documenting all rate limits per endpoint (auth, upload, transcribe, burn, script). Include retry strategies for clients.

name: Backend: Add HTTP caching headers for video streaming
done_when: GET /api/videos/{id}/video includes ETag and Cache-Control headers. Conditional requests (If-None-Match) return 304. SRT/VTT downloads include proper headers.

name: E2E: Full upload-to-download flow test
done_when: Add E2E test for complete flow: upload video file → wait for transcription → edit subtitle text → download SRT. Test passes reliably.

name: Maintenance: Compact PROGRESS.md
done_when: PROGRESS.md is reduced to under 200 lines. Detailed task notes moved to specs/ or archived. Only recent and significant items remain.

name: Backend: Email verification for registration
done_when: POST /api/auth/register sends verification email. Account disabled until verified. GET /api/auth/verify?token= activates account. Resend verification endpoint. Frontend shows 'check your email' message.

name: Backend: CSRF protection for state-changing endpoints
done_when: Add CSRF token to session. All POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints require valid X-CSRF-Token header. Frontend includes token in requests. Tests verify protection.

name: Docs: Update specs/lyrics-alignment.md to match implementation
done_when: Spec updated to reflect actual implementation status. Mark Phase 1-3 as done. Note Phase 4 (chorus template timing) as partially implemented. Remove outdated API changes section.

name: Backend: Chorus template alignment
done_when: When aligning lyrics with detected chorus repeats, use timing from first chorus occurrence as template. Adjust for audio position. Add test with repeated chorus lyrics.

name: Frontend: Remove debug console.log statements
done_when: Remove console.log statements in upload.astro (lines 1125, 1151). Keep console.error for logout failures. verify-all.sh passes.

name: Backend: Add error handling for rand.Read
done_when: generateRequestID() and generateID() functions in main.go and db/db.go handle rand.Read errors. Replace panic in csrf/csrf.go with proper error propagation. Tests pass.

name: Backend: Make configuration values environment variables
done_when: MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE, UPLOAD_DIR, DB_PATH, KEY_PATH are configurable via env vars with sensible defaults. Update specs/deployment.md and backend/README.md. Tests pass.

name: Backend: Validate X-Forwarded-For header trust
done_when: Rate limiter only trusts X-Forwarded-For when TRUST_PROXY env var is set. Document in specs/deployment.md. Tests verify both trusted and untrusted modes.

name: Frontend: Add maximum time validation for subtitle editor
done_when: Time input parsing in upload.astro validates against reasonable max (e.g., 24 hours). Show error for invalid times. Tests pass.

name: Frontend: Clean up event listeners in upload.astro
done_when: Add cleanup for event listeners in setupSubtitleSync() and polling functions. Use AbortController for fetch cleanup. No memory leaks in long sessions.

name: Docs: Update auth.md with planned security features
done_when: specs/auth.md lists account lockout, CAPTCHA, and IP-blocking as 'Future Enhancements' instead of 'Not Implemented'. Clear distinction between current and planned features.

name: Backend: Add encryption environment variables
done_when: AGE_KEY_PATH and ENCRYPTION_ENABLED environment variables added. Update specs/encryption.md. Default behavior unchanged. Tests pass.

name: Frontend: Add TypeScript interfaces for transcription segments
done_when: Create interfaces for TranscriptionSegment, TranscriptionResult in frontend. Replace any[] types in upload.astro with proper types. TypeScript build passes.

name: Backend: Add configurable rate limits via environment variables
done_when: Rate limits (AUTH_RATE_LIMIT, UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT, etc.) configurable via env vars with sensible defaults. Document in backend/README.md. Tests pass.

name: Frontend: Namespace localStorage keys
done_when: All localStorage keys (session_id, theme, csrf_token) prefixed with 'subtitler:' to avoid collisions. Update all read/write code. Tests pass.

name: Backend: Add HTTP range requests for video streaming
done_when: GET /api/videos/{id}/video supports Range header for efficient video seeking. Return 206 Partial Content. Test with curl Range requests.

name: Backend: Add SQLite database maintenance scheduler
done_when: Background task runs VACUUM and ANALYZE periodically (configurable interval). Log maintenance operations. Document in deployment.md.

name: SECURITY: Fix My Videos page showing all users' videos
done_when: GET /api/videos only returns videos owned by authenticated user OR matching session_id for anonymous. Frontend passes session_id in query param for anonymous users. Backend returns 403 if no filter criteria. Tests verify privacy.

name: Frontend: Add cookie consent banner
done_when: Show cookie consent banner on first visit. Store consent in localStorage. Block upload processing until cookies accepted. Consent required for session_id tracking.

name: Backend: Add magic link (passwordless) authentication
done_when: POST /api/auth/magic-link sends login URL via email. GET /api/auth/magic-link/verify validates token and creates session. No password required. Update login page with 'Email me a login link' option. Update specs/auth.md.

name: Backend: Add language override for transcription
done_when: POST /api/transcribe/{id} accepts optional 'language' param (ISO 639-1 code). Pass to whisper-server instead of 'auto'. Frontend upload page shows detected language and allows override before/after transcription. Tests pass.

name: Frontend: Add video player to My Videos page
done_when: View button on My Videos page opens modal/expandable view showing video player with synced subtitles, similar to upload page. No redirect needed. Includes SRT/VTT/JSON download buttons.

name: Docs: Add production debugging guide
done_when: Add 'Production Debugging' section to README.md with journalctl commands for backend (subtitler.service), Caddy logs, whisper-server logs. Include common issues and log locations. Reference specs/deployment.md.

name: Frontend: Add language selection UI for transcription
done_when: Upload page shows detected language after transcription completes. Add language selector dropdown before/during transcription to override auto-detect. Call POST /api/transcribe/{id}?language=XX with selected code. Store preferred language in localStorage.

name: Security: Add account lockout after failed login attempts
done_when: After 5 failed login attempts for an email within 15 minutes, lock account for 15 minutes. Lockout tracked in database with automatic expiry. Tests verify lockout behavior and automatic unlock. Update specs/auth.md.

name: Security: Validate uploaded files are actually videos
done_when: Upload endpoint uses ffprobe to verify file is valid video before accepting (not just MIME type check). Rejects files that claim video/* but are not valid media. Tests verify rejection of fake video files with video MIME types.

name: Security: Add Content Security Policy headers
done_when: Backend or Caddy adds CSP headers to all responses. Policy allows necessary scripts/styles but blocks inline execution. Document CSP policy in specs/auth.md security section. Test headers are present.

name: Backend: Add database migration system
done_when: Use golang-migrate or similar. Migration files in backend/migrations/ as versioned .sql files. Current schema version tracked in database. Add command to apply migrations. Existing schema captured as v1 migration.

name: Docs: Create environment variable reference
done_when: Create docs/ENV.md with all environment variables in table format: name, default value, required/optional, description, example. Cover backend, whisper-server, and deployment config. Cross-reference from README.md.

name: Frontend: Add video thumbnail generation
done_when: Upload generates thumbnail (frame at 10% of video duration) using ffmpeg. My Videos page shows thumbnail preview for each video. Clicking thumbnail opens video player modal. Thumbnails stored encrypted like videos.

name: Frontend: Add progress indicator for subtitle burning
done_when: Burn job stores progress percentage in database. Frontend polls for progress and shows progress bar. Estimated time remaining displayed based on video duration. Tests verify progress updates.

name: Backend: Add structured logging
done_when: Replace log.Printf with structured logger (slog or zerolog). Use log levels (Debug, Info, Warn, Error). Include context fields (request_id, user_id, video_id). Configure via LOG_LEVEL env var (default: info). Tests verify log output.

name: Backend: Authenticated health check with restricted public response
done_when: GET /api/health returns only {"status": "ok"} or {"status": "degraded"} for unauthenticated requests. Authenticated requests (valid session cookie) receive full response with db_connected, whisper_available, disk_space_ok, disk_free_gb, and errors array. Tests verify both response formats.

name: Cleanup: Remove hardcoded /home/trevor/go/bin/go paths
done_when: All hardcoded Go paths replaced with just 'go' in: scripts/*.sh, playwright.config.ts, CLAUDE.md, README.md, INSTALL.md, TESTING.md, backend/README.md, specs/*.md, AGENTS.md. Assumes Go is in PATH. verify-all.sh passes.

name: IMPORTANT Backend/Frontend: Implement chunked uploads for large videos
done_when: Frontend splits large video files (>50MB) into chunks and uploads sequentially with resumability. Backend accepts chunks via POST /api/upload/chunk with chunk index and upload session ID, reassembles on completion. Progress tracked per-chunk. Works through Cloudflare's 100MB free-tier limit. Existing single-file upload still works for small files. E2E test with large file mock. Update specs/subtitler.md with chunked upload design.

name: Backend: Handle database errors in chunked upload progress
done_when: Lines 2867-2868 and 2955-2956 in main.go properly handle errors from GetTotalReceivedBytes and CountUploadChunks. Log errors and return sensible defaults instead of ignoring. Tests pass.

name: Security: Add CAPTCHA to registration and login
done_when: Integrate hCaptcha or reCAPTCHA on registration and login forms. Backend validates token before processing. Configurable via CAPTCHA_SECRET env var. Tests mock CAPTCHA validation.

name: Security: Add password complexity requirements
done_when: Password must contain at least: 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, 1 number, 1 special character. Frontend shows requirements, backend enforces. Update validation.ts and backend auth. Tests verify rejection of weak passwords.

name: Backend: Add encryption key rotation support
done_when: Support for rotating age encryption keys. Re-encrypt files with new key during idle periods. Document rotation procedure in specs/encryption.md. Store key version per file.

name: Backend: Add incomplete upload session cleanup
done_when: cleanupExpiredFiles() scheduler also removes orphaned chunk files from incomplete upload sessions. Log cleanup operations. Document timeout behavior in specs/chunked-upload.md.

name: Frontend: Add localStorage cleanup for stale upload sessions
done_when: On app startup, check localStorage for upload sessions older than 48 hours and remove them. Prevents localStorage pollution from abandoned uploads.

name: Docs: Document whisper model selection decision
done_when: Update specs/subtitler.md with final whisper model choice (large-v3, turbo, or medium). Include rationale based on cost/speed/accuracy tradeoffs. Remove TBD status.

name: Backend: Add DELETE endpoint for videos
done_when: DELETE /api/videos/{id} allows users to delete their own videos. Cascade deletion of transcriptions, burn jobs, and associated files (video, thumbnail, chunks). Authorization checks (user owns video or session_id matches for anonymous). Tests verify deletion and authorization.

name: SECURITY: Fix XSS via innerHTML in frontend
done_when: Replace innerHTML usage with safe DOM methods in videos.astro and upload.astro. Use textContent for user text, createElement for structure. Create escapeHtml utility if needed. No innerHTML with user-controlled data. Tests verify escaping.

name: Backend: Add pagination to video listing
done_when: GET /api/videos accepts limit (default 50, max 100) and offset query params. Response includes total_count and has_more fields. Frontend videos.astro shows pagination controls. Tests verify pagination.

name: Backend: Add rate limiting to download endpoints
done_when: GET /api/videos/{id}/video, /burned, /thumbnail rate limited (e.g., 30/min per IP). Prevents bandwidth abuse and CPU exhaustion from repeated decryption. Tests verify 429 response.

name: Backend: Add input length validation
done_when: Enforce max lengths: segment text (10KB), email (254 chars), password (128 chars). Return 400 with clear error for oversized input. Document limits in API.md. Tests pass.

name: Backend: Improve error messages for production
done_when: Create user-friendly error messages that don't leak paths/implementation details. Add LOG_VERBOSE env var for detailed errors (default false). Document in ENV.md. Tests verify production error format.

name: Backend: Add explicit path validation for file operations
done_when: Create pathValidator utility that uses filepath.Clean and verifies paths stay within intended directories (uploads/, data/). Use on all file operations. Tests verify path traversal prevention.

name: Security: Add HSTS and additional security headers
done_when: Add Strict-Transport-Security header when HTTPS_ONLY=true. Add Permissions-Policy to disable unnecessary features. Document headers in specs/auth.md. Tests verify headers present.

name: Backend: Add soft subtitles option for faster embedding
done_when: Add 'embed' mode to burn endpoint that uses -c:s mov_text to create soft subtitle track instead of burning. Much faster since no re-encoding. Add mode parameter to POST /api/videos/{id}/burn (default: burn, options: burn, embed). Frontend shows option to user. Update docs/API.md.

name: Backend: Fix Devanagari/Indic font rendering in burned subtitles
done_when: Add font parameter to ffmpeg subtitles filter using a font that supports Devanagari (e.g., Noto Sans Devanagari). Document required system fonts in INSTALL.md. Test with Hindi subtitles.

name: SECURITY: Apply pathvalidator to file-serving endpoints
done_when: Use pathvalidator package in video download, thumbnail, and burned video endpoints to validate file paths before serving with http.ServeFile(). Ensure paths stay within uploads/ and data/ directories. Tests verify path traversal is blocked.

name: Backend: Persist CSRF secret across restarts
done_when: When CSRF_SECRET env var is not set, generate secret, save to data/csrf.key, and load on subsequent restarts. Prevents session invalidation on server restart. Document behavior in ENV.md.

name: Frontend: Consolidate duplicate escapeHtml functions
done_when: Remove duplicate escapeHtml implementations from upload.astro, videos.astro, and security.astro. Import from utils/html.ts instead. verify-all.sh passes.

name: Frontend: Add focus management to video modal
done_when: When video modal opens, focus is moved to modal. Keyboard navigation trapped inside modal. Focus restored to trigger button on close. Test with keyboard-only navigation.

name: Frontend: Add upload timeout mechanism
done_when: Add AbortController with configurable timeout (default 5 minutes) to file uploads. Show user-friendly timeout error. Allow retry. Document timeout in UI.

name: Frontend: Add aria-labels to download buttons
done_when: VTT and JSON download buttons have descriptive aria-labels like 'Download subtitles in VTT format'. Test with screen reader.

name: Backend: Add file access audit logging
done_when: Log file downloads (video, thumbnail, burned) with request_id, user_id/session_id, file_id, and client IP. Use structured logging. Helps audit access patterns.

name: Backend: Add max limit validation for pagination
done_when: GET /api/videos enforces maximum limit (100). If client requests limit > 100, cap at 100 instead of allowing unbounded queries. Add test.

name: Backend: Add database indices for frequent queries
done_when: Add migration with indices on: users(email), videos(user_id), videos(session_id), sessions(user_id), sessions(expires_at), transcriptions(video_id). Verify query performance improvement.

name: Frontend: Add undo/redo to subtitle editor
done_when: Implement undo/redo stack for subtitle text and timing edits. Ctrl+Z for undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z for redo. Show undo/redo buttons with disabled state when stack empty. Store up to 50 history states. Tests pass.

name: Frontend: Add keyboard shortcuts to subtitle editor
done_when: Add keyboard shortcuts: Space (play/pause video), Left/Right arrow (seek 5 seconds), J/K/L (rewind/pause/forward), Tab (next segment), Shift+Tab (previous segment). Show keyboard shortcut help modal. Document in README.

name: Docs: Add disaster recovery procedures
done_when: Create docs/DISASTER_RECOVERY.md with: key loss recovery (unrecoverable), database corruption recovery, server failure procedures, backup verification steps, and restoration runbook. Update specs/deployment.md to reference it.

name: Backend: Add per-user rate limiting for authenticated endpoints
done_when: Implement per-user rate limits in addition to per-IP limits. Authenticated users limited to 60 req/min across all endpoints (configurable via USER_RATE_LIMIT env var). Returns 429 with X-RateLimit-Remaining header. Tests pass.

name: Backend: Add Prometheus metrics endpoint
